brief: A campfire burning steadily. Continuous natural crackling fire, low flame roar and soft sizzling embers, with occasional wood pops. Close microphone recording of the burning fire.
The continuous sound of a small wood fire burning. Steady warm fire crackling and a soft underlying rushing flame sound, irregular crackling embers. Close-up sound effect recording.
Campfire crackling. A quiet continuous burning wood fire, soft flames hiss and flutter, embers softly crumble and logs crackle with occasional sharper pops. Clean close recording of the fire itself.
